record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: MARSHTOMP, MUDKIP and SWAMPERT (the queued units; the only units declaring MUD_BUBBLE in the catalog). The WATER_SPRING passive of these units is separate and not described here.

dispatch.note: requiresTarget is false: MovingState casts it with a null target as soon as pp >= maxPP and canCast, without first walking up to an enemy; AttackingState can also cast it with a target, but the strategy ignores the target either way

record.summary: Self-heal: the caster heals itself by a requested 10 / 20 / 40 / 80 (80 fallback) by caster stars, scaled by its own AP and by its crit factor if the cast crit, then resets its attack cooldown to a short 250 ms-based value so it attacks again quickly.

targeting.who: the caster only (heal target and caster are the same entity); the cast target is unused

effects.scaling: requested amount: heal x (1 + 1 x AP/100) (apBoost 1 is passed) and x critPower if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied amount: PokemonState.handleHeal gives 0 if the caster is wounded (and under BLOODMOON weather with Blood Stones converts that into a shield of 0.3 x stones x heal), and nothing if hp is 0 or protect is on; otherwise x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather; rounded and capped at the caster's missing HP; an overheal with a GRASS synergy effect adds 0.4 x overheal max HP

declaredRaw.formula: cooldown = round(250 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) using the caster's current speed
declaredRaw.note: requested; with the catalog speed 44 this gives 353, a different number if speed is changed in the fight

effects.resolution: sets pokemon.cooldown (the attack timer): AttackingState attacks only when cooldown <= 0 and counts it down by dt, so the caster waits that many ms before its next basic attack; it replaces whatever value cooldown had (also a longer one)

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry 80 and the fallback 80 are not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). Cooldown reset (250) does not depend on stars. maxPP is 60 and range 1 for all three.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept; each cast heals independently and resets the cooldown again. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested heal: 10 (MUDKIP) / 20 (MARSHTOMP) / 40 (SWAMPERT). Requested = declared x (1 + AP/100) x critPower-if-crit; received heal after the burn / enraged / buff / weather modifiers, rounding and the cap at missing HP (0 when wounded or protected). Cooldown requested 250 base, applied round(250 / (0.4 + 0.007 x speed)).
